name: "CI Reviewer"
provider: "custom:my-gw"
model: "gw-model-1"
system_prompt: "Review the diff.\n  Indented line: with a colon # and \"quotes\"\n\ttabbed line  \n"
skills: []
strategy: "single-pass"
ci_fail_on: "critical"
version: 1
custom_provider:
  protocol: "openai"
  auth_mode: "bearer"
  auth_header: null
  extra_headers:
    - "X-Tenant"
    - "X-Project"
  structured_output: "strict"
  pricing:
    promptPerM: 1.5
    completionPerM: 6

name: DevDigest Review · ci-reviewer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  review:
    name: DevDigest Review · ci-reviewer
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64]
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run the DevDigest review
        shell: bash
        run: |
          base64 -d .devdigest/runner/devdigest-runner-linux-amd64.gz.b64 | gzip -dc > "$RUNNER_TEMP/devdigest-runner"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP" && sha256sum --check --strict "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.devdigest/runner/devdigest-runner-linux-amd64.sha256"
          chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/devdigest-runner"
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && "$RUNNER_TEMP/devdigest-runner"
        env:
          DEVDIGEST_LLM_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.DEVDIGEST_MY_GW_BASE_URL }}
          DEVDIGEST_LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVDIGEST_MY_GW_API_KEY }}
          DEVDIGEST_LLM_HEADER_1: ${{ secrets.DEVDIGEST_MY_GW_HEADER_1 }}
          DEVDIGEST_LLM_HEADER_2: ${{ secrets.DEVDIGEST_MY_GW_HEADER_2 }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          DEVDIGEST_AGENT: ci-reviewer
          DEVDIGEST_POST_AS: github_review
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Upload the review result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: devdigest-result-ci-reviewer
          path: devdigest-result.json
